title: 🎟️slots booking
description:
🎟️ Slot Booking

Slot booking is available Monday to Saturday.

For Sunday, advance slot booking is also available from Monday to Saturday. Customers can select Sunday while making their booking during the Monday–Saturday booking period.

Please book your slot in advance to avoid waiting time, especially for weekends and Sundays.

title: Weekend Booking Advice
description: Weekends fill up rapidly! Daily ticket limit is 50 entries. Pre-register your slots early to secure entry.
